note: upstream_ids are the NFRx.y IDs the sensor derives from this unit's nfr-design artifacts. D1 provisions no infrastructure, so most of these are application-level requirements with no infrastructure expression and are recorded N/A with the reason rather than claimed as covered. The OK rows are the ones infrastructure genuinely carries: the deployment and migration properties, the pipeline gates, the alerting and retention tables, and the named gaps. NFR6.1 and NFR12.1 are citations of the prior record's rules. The observability IDs cited in monitoring-design.md (NFR12.9, NFR12.11, NFR24.1-24.3, NFR25.1, NFR25.4, NFR25.6, NFR25.7, NFR26.1, NFR26.2) are not derived as upstream: the sensor reads the nfr-design files and observability-design.md is not among them. They are declared in the reverse array so the monitoring design is not carrying requirements no coverage file mentions.
